## Suggested README Section

Add this section to your main README.md:

```markdown
## 🔄 CI/CD Status

[![Docker Build](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/docker-build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/docker-build.yml)
[![Backend CI](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/backend-ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/backend-ci.yml)
[![Dashboard CI](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/dashboard-ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/dashboard-ci.yml)
[![Security Scan](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/security-scan.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/security-scan.yml)
[![Code Quality](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/code-quality.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/khulnasoft/cyberpot/actions/workflows/code-quality.yml)

CyberPot uses automated CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, and deploying. See [CI/CD Documentation](.github/CI_CD.md) for details.
```

## Custom Badge Colors

You can customize badge colors using shields.io:

```markdown
![Custom Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CyberPot-Production-brightgreen)
![Custom Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Hardened-blue)
![Custom Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Multi--Arch-amd64%20%7C%20arm64-orange)
```

---

**Note**: Replace `khulnasoft` with your GitHub username/organization if you've forked the repository.
